blind.description: A vertical wooden barrel constructed from textured brown wood staves and bound with two dark iron hoops. The barrel is filled to the brim with salted fish, featuring greyish fish bodies with dorsal fins and tail fins protruding through a thick layer of coarse white salt crystals. The mesh is solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled without floating artifacts, holes, or melting. It rests directly on its flat bottom.
blind.from_above: A circular wooden rim showing the top ends of the barrel staves, enclosing tightly packed greyish fish and fins heavily coated in white crystalline salt lumps.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40-45% the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.3 to 2.6 feet tall) and roughly 2 feet in diameter at the bulge.
